upstream.authentication: Primary upstream HTTPS archive download matched the primary upstream HTTPS published SHA256. PGP signature retained as provenance, not independently verified.
upstream.source_date_epoch_origin: VERSION mtime in the pinned release tar archive

retained_receive_features: incremental UUID and received-UUID parent lookup
encoded write with upstream decompression fallback
build.reproducibility_boundary: Pinned pristine upstream archive and fixed recipe/options; build manifest records actual native toolchain and static library hashes. Identical output across different toolchain/library inputs is not asserted. No build was performed when this provenance was captured.

receiver_contract.launch: Authenticate and open static ELF before chroot; child fchdir(detached Btrfs top-level FD), chroot('.'), chdir('/'), then fexecve(executable FD). Kernel execveat support is required; do not rely on a /proc/self/fd fallback.
receiver_contract.root: Btrfs filesystem top-level subvolume ID 5, containing the incoming directory and the unchanged received parent/clone roots. Root need not be attached to any namespace.
receiver_contract.input: Send stream on inherited standard input; inherited stdout/stderr for diagnostics. -e accepts one stream through its first END command.
receiver_contract.proc_dev: The inspected startup, receive and UUID lookup paths require no /proc or /dev mount: explicit -m / bypasses mount discovery and stdin bypasses file input. This is source-derived, not an executed chroot receive result.
receiver_contract.parent_lookup: TREE_SEARCH UUID/received-UUID and INO_LOOKUP on open('/') resolve subvolume paths, then openat(mnt_fd, parent path). Preserve parent received_uuid and stransid; use matching immutable parent on send side.
receiver_contract.privilege: Receiver needs the normal Btrfs receive privileges for tree search, snapshot creation, metadata ownership/xattrs/device nodes and encoded writes as applicable. chroot is not a substitute for trusted send-stream input or controller admission/lifetime enforcement.
upstream_limitations: FILEATTR is intentionally ignored upstream (cmds/receive.c:1345-1376), as in upstream stream v1 behavior; this package does not claim to restore otherwise unsupported inode attributes.
Encoded stream encryption is rejected by upstream; this package does not add encryption support.

local_prerequisite_observation.action: Supply native LZO2 development headers and static library through the separately authorized host dependency preparation (Debian package liblzo2-dev). Do not disable LZO receive support. No package installation or build performed.
